services.name: Tandem Jumps
services.desc: The tandem skydive is our recommended method to experience the sky for the first time. With less than an hour of training, you will be ready to make your first skydive! On a tandem skydive, one of our USPA-certified instructors will guide you through the jump from exit to landing. As the student, you will wear a harness attached to your instructor's harness at each shoulder and each hip. Your instructor's parachute system has two parachutes, each supersized for two people and capable of safely bringing you back down to earth. All you have to do is enjoy the view! blurb: Skydive K-State is the official parachute club of Kansas State University. We offer tandem skydives, solo static line training, and professional exhibition jumps. Open to all (not just students), we are a club-oriented dropzone serving Abilene, Salina, Manhattan, Topeka, and the surrounding area. All of our instructors are certified by the United States Parachute Association (USPA), and our equipment exceeds FAA
